paite: Huan zawlneite, zawlnei Haggai leh Zekariah Iddo tapa in Judah leh Jerusalem a om Judate kiang ah athu agenkhol ua; akiang uah Israel' Pathian min in thu agenkhol uhi.
heading: Tempul Lamna Nasep Pat Nawnna

paite: Huchi in Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak tapa Jeshua athou ua, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn alam panta ua; amaute panpih in akiang uah Pathian zawlneite a-om uhi.

Huchih lai mah in akiang uah Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa leh Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpihte uh ahong ua, akiang uah hichibang in, hiai inn lam ding leh hiai kulhbaang zou ding in kua'n thu ahon pia a? achi uhi.
Huai ban ah ka kiang uah, "Hiai inn lam mite min bang ahia?" chi in ahong dong uhi.
Himahleh Juda upate tung ah a Pathian uh mit atu a, athu Darias kiang a ahong tun a, huai tungtang laikhak a dawnna ahong kik nawn masiah, amaute akhawlsak kei uhi.
Laikhak teisawn Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa leh Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpih Abharsa mite, luipi khen a omte'n kumpipa Darias akhak uhi.
Akiang ah laikhak akhak uh hichibang a gelh ahi. "Darias kumpipa kiang ah khamuanna kim om hen.
Kumpipa'n thei hen, Judia bial ah ka pai ua, suang thupite a lam, Pathian thupi inn ah, kulhbaangte singte akikoih a, hiai nasep thanopna toh apai zel a, akhut uah ma asawn zel hi.
Huai upate thu ka dong ua, hichibang in akiang uah, 'Hiai inn lam ding leh hiai kulhbaang zou ding in nou kuan thu ahon pia a?' ka chi uhi.
Nang kiang a tel mahmah gen thei ding in, aminte uh leng ka dong ua, huchi a amau makaipen a om mite min ka gelhkhiak theihna ding un.
Huchi in hichibang in kou ahon dawng uhi, 'Van leh lei Pathian sikhate ka hi ua, hiai inn kum tampi a na kilamsa, Israel kumpipa thupi in alam leh azohsa inn ka lam uhi.
Himahleh ka pipute un van Pathian a na suk heh nung un, amaute Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, Kaldai mi khut ah apia a, ama'n hiai inn ahihsia a, mite Babulon lam ah apimang hi.
Himahleh Babulon kumpipa Kura akum khatna kum in, kumpipa Kura in hiai Pathian inn lam ding in thupiak abawl hi.

Dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan Pathian inn ate leng, Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a om Pathian inn a kipan a alakkhiak a, Babulon tempul a laklutte, huaite kumpipa Kura in Babulon tempul a kipan alakhia a, mi khat Sesbazzar, ukpipa dia abawl kiang ah huaite apekhia hi.'
Ama'n akiang ah, 'Hiai tui-um belsuan la inla, pai in, Jerusalem a om tempul ah koih in, amun ah Pathian inn lam hi hen,' achi hi.
Huai lai in Sesbazzar ahong a, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn suangphumte aphum a: huai hun a kipan tutan in lam in a-om a, hinapi in lah zoh ahi kei hi.

Huaiziak in tu in kumpipa'n hoih asakleh, Babulon a om, kumpipa laigelhte koihchingna insung kizong henla, Jerusalem a hiai Pathian inn lam ding kumpipa Kura in thupiak bawlna hiam abawlleh, hiai thu ah kumpipa'n akipahna kou hon khak hen," chi in.
